description: Deterministic navigation graph for the Orvek repository.

node_kinds.component: A curated architectural responsibility spanning one or more files.
node_kinds.dependency: A direct Cargo dependency outside this workspace.
node_kinds.directory: A directory containing indexed source or supporting files.
node_kinds.file: A version-controlled input file, excluding generated graph outputs.
node_kinds.module: A Rust module inferred from a source path.
node_kinds.package: A Cargo package discovered in the source tree; workspace_member states whether it belongs to the workspace.
node_kinds.target: A Rust target group inferred from explicit Cargo declarations and conventional source locations.
node_kinds.workspace: The Cargo workspace declared by the root manifest.

nodes.label: CLI and configuration boundary
nodes.summary: Parses commands, loads configuration and dispatches terminal, headless, host, memory and review flows.

nodes.label: Verification and delivery
nodes.summary: Records verification evidence and reproduces patch artifacts from controlled snapshots before delivery.

nodes.label: Sandbox executor
nodes.summary: Defines the bounded executor transport and packaged Linux supervisor used by the harness runtime.

nodes.label: Authoritative harness
nodes.summary: Owns admission, contracts, queueing, durable task state, evidence, completion and recovery.

nodes.label: Headless JSONL projection
nodes.summary: Submits a task to the same host and emits the durable session and linked-task projection for automation.

nodes.label: Detached host client
nodes.summary: Owns compatible-host connection, local IPC requests, watch reconnection and uncertain submission acknowledgement.

nodes.label: Detached host server
nodes.summary: Starts the detached host process, constructs provider and executor dependencies, and serves harness IPC.

nodes.label: Shared memory
nodes.summary: Provides bounded local SQLite and optional remote memory stores, client, server and tool contracts.

nodes.label: Build, release and evaluation automation
nodes.summary: Contains workspace commands, CI, Docker packaging, Harbor evaluation adapter and source-tree audits.

nodes.label: Browser review
nodes.summary: Serves review assets and maps browser feedback to authenticated host review commands.

nodes.label: Inference and execution runtime
nodes.summary: Builds bounded model context, drives provider turns and mediates workspace capabilities and execution.

nodes.label: Session assembly
nodes.summary: Resolves a workspace, selects skills and memory, and admits or resumes a host session.

nodes.label: Isolated subagents
nodes.summary: Owns session-scoped child admission, lifecycle, messaging and retained observation state.

nodes.label: Terminal presentation
nodes.summary: Maintains disposable UI state and projects authoritative host journal records into panes and transcript components.

relationship_kinds.admits_through: The source component asks the target component to admit a session.
relationship_kinds.certifies_with: The source component relies on the target component for verification or delivery evidence.
relationship_kinds.connects_to: The source component connects to the target component over the local host boundary.
relationship_kinds.contains: The source node contains the target node.
relationship_kinds.creates: The source component creates the target component.
relationship_kinds.declared_in: The source package or workspace is declared by the target manifest file.
relationship_kinds.declares_module: The source Rust module declares the target Rust module through a file-backed mod declaration.
relationship_kinds.defines: The source package defines the target Rust crate target.
relationship_kinds.depends_on: The source Cargo package directly depends on the target package or external dependency.
relationship_kinds.executes_through: The source component runs commands through the target component.
relationship_kinds.implemented_by: The source module or component is implemented by the target source file.
relationship_kinds.imports: The source Rust module imports the target direct Cargo dependency.
relationship_kinds.imports_local: The source TypeScript or Python file imports the target local source file.
relationship_kinds.includes: The source Rust module includes the target tracked file at compile time.
relationship_kinds.links_to: The source Markdown file links to the target local file.
relationship_kinds.manages: The source component manages the target capability through its command surface.
relationship_kinds.member_of: The source package belongs to the target workspace.
relationship_kinds.orchestrates: The source component coordinates the target component.
relationship_kinds.packages_and_evaluates: The source component packages or evaluates the target component.
relationship_kinds.patches: The source workspace redirects the named registry package to the target vendored package.
relationship_kinds.queries: The source component acts as a client of the target component.
relationship_kinds.serves: The source component hosts the target component's authority.
relationship_kinds.starts: The source component starts the target component.
relationship_kinds.uses: The source component uses the target capability directly.
relationship_kinds.validates_configuration_of: The source component validates the target capability configuration without making it host session state.

excluded: Git internals, build outputs and ignored dependency environments.
Derived graph.json and architecture.dot outputs to avoid self-reference.
scope.included: Version-controlled repository inputs plus the authored graph entry documents.
limitations: Rust module links cover file-backed mod declarations, including conditional #[path] alternatives; inline modules and macro-generated code are not expanded.
Rust import links cover direct first-party package imports; Cargo dependency links are the complete direct package-level view.
Curated component edges describe architecture and do not replace source-level dependency analysis.
